Requests are harder, leads cost more, few reach a contract

What the subscription includes

Presales automation and new customers in one account

The subscription is more than leads. The platform takes over the routine between a customer request and the proposal, both for your own customers and for the ones we bring. We don't sell equipment and don't compete with you.

assignmentCustomer spec, automatically

A manufacturer's shop-floor request becomes a technical spec: weight, rate, accuracy, shop conditions, constraints. Your engineer doesn't spend hours on emails.

manage_searchEquipment selection from your catalog

The platform picks the items that fit the spec and explains the choice. For example, for welding car body parts it suggests at least 3 models with the right reach and payload.

request_quoteProposal in your template

A technical and commercial proposal is built for the specific customer in your template. Your manager only reviews and sends it.

trending_upJustification for the customer

Payback and how the project fits into the existing production. It's easier for the customer to approve the budget and for you to close the deal.

group_addQualified requests from manufacturers

We bring customers who have already defined their task. Each request is matched to your product range, references and region, and the contact arrives together with the spec.

insightsAnalytics and integrations

Request and conversion analytics, data exchange with ERP and MES via REST API on higher plans.

FAQ

FAQ for vendors

What does the subscription include besides leads?

Presales automation for all your requests: a spec from the customer's description, equipment selection from your catalog, a payback estimate and a proposal in your template. Requests from manufacturers we bring come on top.

Can I process my own customers' requests?

Yes. Upload the customer's request to your account and the platform prepares the spec, selection and proposal. There's no commission on your own customers.

How does the 1% commission work?

It applies only to deals with customers we brought. You don't pay for your own customers, even if you prepared the spec and proposal in the platform. No deal, no commission. The terms are set out in the contract.

What's included in the free pilot?

The first month and up to 100 requests: catalog and proposal template setup, an account for your team, specs, selections and proposals for your requests, and requests from us. No commitment: if it's not a fit, simply don't renew.

How much does it cost after the pilot?

From $1,290 per month. The price depends on the number of catalogs, users and the request limit; paying for 3 months is cheaper. We'll send full pricing on request.

How do I connect my catalog and proposal template?

Send us your catalog, template and sample proposals and specs in whatever form you have them. We handle the setup: one call from you, 14 days to launch from us.

Can it connect to CRM, ERP or MES?

Yes, the Professional plan includes data exchange via REST API. Custom integrations are available on the Enterprise plan.
